soldier: Head of the soldier yellowish brown, nasus reddish brown, antennae brownish yellow; anterior part of the pronotum brown, mesonotal and metanotal tergites, abdomen and legs pale yellowish brown, sternites slightly darker. The surface of the head sparsely beset with fine short hairs, becoming denser towards the nasus, the hairs at the tip of the nasus long and dense; thoracic and abdominal tergites sparsely hairy, the hairs of the abdomen and of the posterior margins of the tergites near the abdominal apex of unequal length. Head circular, widest about the middle, the middle of the posterior margin nearly straight. Nasus conical, the width at the base about twice the width at mid-length, its length about two thirds of the head length; in lateral view the nasus extending straight forwards, its axis nearly parallel to the ventral margin of the head, the basal peak of the nasus faintly discernible, the occiput slightly extended backwards. The apical spine of the mandibles slender and acute; the basal mandibular tooth plate of the right mandible with about seven grooves. Antennae with 13 to 14 segments, segment 3 longer than segment 2, segment 4 shorter; postmentum hexagonal, the anterior and posterior lateral margins slightly concave. Pronotum saddle-shaped, about 2.4 times as wide as long, the anterior margin slightly concave in the middle or nearly straight, the posterior margin nearly straight. Hind femur extending beyond the middle of the abdomen, the hind tibia about 1.13 times the head length and 1.23 times the head width.
